label: Finite interpretations for the round 3 Cogito/existence-base batch: omission models for every…
meaning: Finite interpretations for the round 3 batch, all proved without axioms: an omission model for every premise of the ten derivations other than excluded middle (a performed doubt with no occurring thought; no performed doubt; a borne willing; an assent without opining; a selected candidate that bears nothing, is abstract, or is absent; a self-grounding concretum with no rank, no well-founded grounding or cone and no borrowing cut; a contingent root cone; a capable deprived non-potent subject; a privation with the act; motion without capacity; an unactualized capacity not counted as potency), and joint witnesses with a performed doubt, a real grounding edge from a necessary root to a contingent selected being, and a potent subject being moved.
